notes: SqueekOdometer is the single contract of Squeek Odometer, a free on-chain dynamic NFT on Sepolia (chain id 11155111). Its constructor takes the Squeekchain release core-sepolia-20261103 addresses, in order: SqueekCore proxy, SqueekNFT (Squeeks) and SqueekStaking proxy; they are immutable. The constructor reverts outside Sepolia (and local chain 31337) and makes no external calls, so a rehearsal on an empty chain succeeds. There is no owner, admin, pause, upgrade, withdrawal, payable function or initialization call; the manifest passes no $owner because the contract has no privileged role. Deployment value is zero. mint() is free, one per wallet, 9,999 in total; refresh(id) and refreshAll() only emit ERC-4906 events. Runtime size from forge build --sizes is 23,212 bytes (initcode 23,947). Deployment gas measured with forge create on a local chain is 5,126,572; a conservative factory estimate of 1,700 gas per runtime byte plus 500,000 gives 39,960,400. No launch token, pool, distributor or ETH funding. Validation and the security handoff are in docs/VALIDATION.md and docs/SECURITY.md.
